rule: every hit of `skeleton_for_joint_names|DETAILED_HUMANOID` in src, scripts and tools (tests excluded), binned by what it does with a track

bins.a: delivery path: MUST read the track's own skeleton (skeleton_for_track / skeleton_for_track_dict / the explicit `skeleton=` argument)
bins.b: canonical by construction: builds or consumes tracks that carry no per-performer rest (generated motion, asset-only consumers, the SMPL-X mocap exporter with its own contract); unchanged, the reason stated
bins.c: instruments reading the delivery: now read the delivered rest from the track file
bins.d: frozen historical gates: untouched, they hold their own skeleton by design

a.src/autoanim_gnm/body.py: BodyTrack carries rest_translations_m (float64, new schema pair 1.2/1.3, legacy loads canonical); __post_init__/validate_body_track/as_dict/from_dict resolve through skeleton_for_track; skeleton_for_track_dict for disk readers
a.src/autoanim_gnm/commercial_multiview.py: positions_to_body_track(skeleton=...) reads `rest` from the skeleton it is given and stamps it on the track; reconstruct_multiview builds performer_skeleton per subject (rest_skeleton='performer'; 'canonical' is the gate's instrument arm)
a.src/autoanim_gnm/body_export.py: node translations = the track's rest in the asset's aligned parent rest frames; root from the track's rest; vertices/weights/inverse-bind unchanged; rest written into the mapping npz
a.src/autoanim_gnm/unified_gltf.py: _skin_matrices and the unified export resolve skeleton_for_track(track)
a.src/autoanim_gnm/body_binding.py:461: asset-only socket; optional skeleton parameter defaulting to the asset's own rest (canonical by construction until a caller passes one)
a.src/autoanim_gnm/performer_skeleton.py: NEW: the delivered rest source (sized_skeleton moved into src, torso-drop derivation folded in); tools/head/sized_skeleton.py re-exports it
a.scripts/verify_commercial_multiview_arti: FK on the track's own rest

b.src/autoanim_gnm/speech_motion.py, speec: generated speech tracks are built with joint_names=DETAILED_HUMANOID.names and no rest: canonical by construction
b.src/autoanim_gnm/soma_motion.py:804: SOMA motion retarget onto the canonical rig; no performer rest exists in that lane
b.src/autoanim_gnm/body_provider.py:496/59: asset generation and manifest validation: the ASSET's skeleton contract, not a track
b.src/autoanim_gnm/body_projection.py:356: callers: scripts/build_video_acting_shot.py only (the video acting lane, canonical generated tracks)
b.scripts/build_audio_acting_shot.py, buil: generated acting shots on the canonical rig
b.scripts/export_mocap_rigify_humanoid.py: the SMPL-X mocap -> Rigify exporter; reads its own SKELETON.json contract, never a BodyTrack

c.tools/compare/mamma_scoreboard.py: arms renamed: `sized` is the DELIVERED body on the rest the track carries (skeleton_for_track_dict); `canon` is a replay on the canonical rig; arm definitions written into the report
c.tools/head/sized_skeleton.py: re-exports performer_skeleton (instrument and delivery cannot diverge)
c.tools/swap-harness/retarget_cost.py: passes the skeleton explicitly to the converter beside the module rebind
c.tools/compare/silhouette.py: reads the delivered GLB through Blender, so it scores whatever the exporter wrote: no edit needed, and it is the instrument that moved 8 of 8 cells

d.tools/compare/d2_clavicle_gate.py, d2c_c: frozen: they reproduce committed D1/D2 reports on the canonical rig and must keep doing so
d.tools/head/our_head_bar.py: reads DETAILED_HUMANOID for NAMES and PARENTS only (chain walking), never a rest offset
